{
  const h = await installation()
  t.after(() => h.close())
  await setup(h)
  assert.equal((await h.request(endpoint, { as: '' })).status, 404)
  const office = await h.person('synthetic-glove-14', 'office')
  await office.run('intake.configure', { version: (await h.state()).business[0].version, enabled: true, siteKey: 'synthetic-glove-11', secret: 'synthetic-glove-12', allowedOrigins: [] }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  const customer = await office.run('customer.save', { name: 'synthetic-glove-15', phone: '+1 212 555 0101', email: 'synthetic-glove-15@example.test' })
  await configure(h)
  const config = await h.request(endpoint, { as: '', headers: { origin: embed } })
  assert.equal(config.headers.get('access-control-allow-origin'), embed)
  assert.deepEqual(await config.json(), { businessName: 'synthetic-glove-13', siteKey: 'synthetic-glove-11', action: 'glove-request' })
  h.turnstile.answer = () => challenge()
  const input = request(), response = await send(h, input)
  assert.equal(response.status, 200, await response.clone().text())
  const receipt = await response.json()
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(receipt).sort(), ['ok', 'receipt'])
  assert.equal(receipt.ok, true)
  const state = await h.state(), enquiry = state.enquiries[0]
  assert.equal(state.customers.length, 1)
  assert.equal(enquiry.customerId, customer.id)
  assert.equal(enquiry.source, 'website')
  assert.equal(enquiry.intake.preferredTimes, input.preferredTimes)
  assert.equal(enquiry.photos.length, 2)
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(state).includes('synthetic-glove-12'))
  assert.ok(!(await (await h.request('/api/glove/export')).text()).includes('synthetic-glove-12'))
  const notices = (await office.state()).notices
  assert.ok(notices.some(n => n.enquiryId === enquiry.id && n.to.includes('office')))
  assert.ok(state.events.some(e => e.kind === 'intake.received' && e.subjectId === enquiry.id))
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(h.turnstile.calls[0]).sort(), ['response', 'secret'])
  const beforeReplay = await durable(h)
  assert.deepEqual(await (await send(h, input)).json(), receipt)
  assert.deepEqual(await durable(h), beforeReplay)
  await h.command('service.save', { code: 'synthetic-glove-21', name: 'synthetic-glove-22', unitPrice: '25.00', tax: 'TAXABLE' })
  await h.command('model.connect', { url: 'https://models.example.test/v1', model: 'synthetic-glove-23', key: 'synthetic-glove-24' })
  h.models.answer = () => ({ title: 'synthetic-glove-25', ...Object.fromEntries(['good', 'better', 'best'].map(tier => [tier, { reason: 'synthetic-glove-26', lines: [{ code: 'synthetic-glove-21', quantity: '1' }] }])) })
  await h.command('quote.suggest', { enquiryId: enquiry.id })
  const modelRequest = JSON.stringify(h.models.calls[0].body)
  assert.ok(modelRequest.includes(input.description))
  assert.ok(!modelRequest.includes(png))
  assert.ok(!modelRequest.includes(input.email))
  assert.ok(!modelRequest.includes(input.address))
  const peer = await h.command('customer.save', { name: 'synthetic-glove-27', phone: '2125550127' })
  const peerRequest = await h.command('enquiry.create', { customerId: peer.id, description: `Coordinate with the request contact ${input.email}`, source: 'phone' })
  const fileId = enquiry.photos[0].file.fileId
  const original = await h.request(`/api/glove/files/${fileId}`, { as: office.cookie })
  assert.equal(original.status, 200)
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(await original.arrayBuffer()).toString('base64'), png)
  assert.equal((await h.request(`/api/glove/files/${fileId}`, { as: '' })).status, 401)
  assert.equal((await h.request(endpoint + '/files/' + fileId, { as: '' })).status, 401)
  await h.command('role.set', { operatorId: office.id, role: 'technician' })
  assert.equal((await h.request(`/api/glove/files/${fileId}`, { as: office.cookie })).status, 404)
  const exported = JSON.parse((await h.command('privacy.export', { customerId: customer.id, version: customer.version })).download)
  assert.equal(exported.files.filter(f => enquiry.photos.some(p => p.file.fileId === f.id)).length, 2)
  const preview = await h.command('privacy.preview', { customerId: customer.id, version: customer.version })
  await h.command('privacy.erase', { customerId: customer.id, version: customer.version, confirm: 'ERASE', fingerprint: preview.fingerprint })
  assert.equal((await h.request(`/api/glove/files/${fileId}`)).status, 404)
  assert.equal((await h.db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM glove_files WHERE capture_id=?').bind(enquiry.id).first()).n, 0)
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify((await h.state()).enquiries).includes(input.description))
  const retained = (await h.state()).enquiries.find(e => e.id === peerRequest.id)
  assert.ok(retained && !retained.description.includes(input.email), 'the newly supplied typed contact is redacted without deleting a peer request')
  assert.equal((await h.state()).customers.find(c => c.id === peer.id).name, peer.name)
  const external = JSON.stringify([...h.turnstile.calls, ...h.marketing, ...h.email.sent])
  assert.ok(!external.includes(input.description))
  assert.ok(!external.includes(png))
}

  const h = await installation({ at: '2026-11-01T12:00:00Z' }); t.after(() => h.close())
  const b = await xeroBusiness(h)
  await h.command('role.save', { name: 'Accounting delegate', permissions: ['xero.sync'] }, { error: 'INPUT' })
  await b.office.run('xero.sync', { kind: 'customer', id: b.customer.id }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  await b.agent.run('xero.reconcile', { kind: 'customer', id: b.customer.id }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  const limited = await h.person('Limited Owner', 'owner')
  await h.command('branch.limit', { operatorId: limited.id, branchId: 'main' })
  await limited.run('xero.sync', { kind: 'customer', id: b.customer.id }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  assert.equal(h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length, 0)
  await h.command('xero.map', { kind: 'service', id: b.service.id, version: (await current(h, 'services', b.service.id)).version, remoteId: 'synthetic-glove-item-0' })
  await xeroSync(h, 'customer', b.customer.id, { error: 'XERO_REVIEW' })
  assert.equal(h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length, 0)
  await h.command('xero.confirmLinks', { version: (await h.state()).business[0].version, confirm: true })
  const customerCommandId = crypto.randomUUID()
  const customerPayload = { kind: 'customer', id: b.customer.id, version: (await current(h, 'customers', b.customer.id)).version }
  const customer = await h.command('xero.sync', customerPayload, { commandId: customerCommandId }); assert.equal(customer.phase, 'complete')
  assert.equal((await h.command('xero.sync', customerPayload, { commandId: customerCommandId })).remoteId, customer.remoteId)
  assert.equal(h.xero.data.Contacts[0].Name, b.customer.name)
  h.xero.reject = `Income account is inactive ${token}`
  const rejected = await xeroSync(h, 'service', b.service.id)
  assert.equal(rejected.phase, 'rejected'); assert.match(rejected.message, /Income account is inactive/); assert.ok(!rejected.message.includes(token))
  h.xero.reject = null
  const service = await current(h, 'services', b.service.id)
  await h.command('service.save', { ...service, description: 'Repaired sales item' })
  assert.equal((await xeroSync(h, 'service', b.service.id)).phase, 'complete')
  assert.equal(h.xero.data.Items[0].Description, 'Repaired sales item')
  const invoice = await qboInvoice(h, b, b.site, 'HVAC service', { kind: 'percent', value: '30', reason: 'Loyalty' }, [{ description: 'Non-taxable maintenance', serviceId: b.service.id, quantity: '1', unitPrice: '30.30', tax: 'FREE' }])
  assert.deepEqual([invoice.revisions.at(-1).totals.total, invoice.revisions.at(-1).totals.gst], ['166.17', '12.66'])
  const draft = await h.command('invoice.revise', { invoiceId: invoice.id, version: invoice.version, lines: invoice.revisions.at(-1).lines.map(line => ({ ...line, description: line.description + ' reviewed' })), discount: invoice.revisions.at(-1).discount, reason: 'Review before first Xero post' })
  const beforeDraft = h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length
  await xeroSync(h, 'invoice', invoice.id, { error: 'NOT_APPROVED' })
  assert.equal(h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length, beforeDraft)
  await h.command('invoice.approve', { invoiceId: invoice.id, version: draft.version, revision: draft.revisions.at(-1).n })
  const settings = (await h.state()).business[0]
  await h.command('business.save', { ...settings, taxSettings: { jurisdictions: [{ id: 'changed', name: 'Changed', rate: '20', zips: [], taxLabor: true }], defaultJurisdictionId: 'changed' } })
  const posted = await xeroSync(h, 'invoice', invoice.id); assert.equal(posted.phase, 'complete')
  const transport = h.xero.calls.find(r => r.body?.Invoices).body.Invoices[0]
  assert.equal(transport.Contact.ContactID, 'synthetic-glove-contact-1')
  assert.equal(transport.Reference, `Property ${b.site.address}`)
  assert.equal(transport.LineItems[0].Description, invoice.revisions.at(-1).lines[0].description + ' reviewed')
  assert.deepEqual(transport.LineItems.map(l => [l.LineAmount, l.DiscountAmount ?? 0, l.TaxAmount]), [[153.51, 35.49, 12.66], [0, 30.3, 0]])
  assert.deepEqual([transport.Date, transport.DueDate], ['2026-11-01', '2026-11-15'])
  assert.equal(h.xero.data.Invoices[0].Total, 166.17)
  const writes = h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length
  for (const [kind, id] of [['customer', b.customer.id], ['service', b.service.id], ['invoice', invoice.id]]) assert.equal((await xeroSync(h, kind, id)).phase, 'complete')
  assert.equal(h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length, writes)
  assert.ok(h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).every(r => r.idempotencyKey))
  const live = await current(h, 'customers', b.customer.id)
  h.xero.uncertain = true
  await h.command('customer.save', { ...live, name: 'Updated billing customer' })
  const unknown = await xeroSync(h, 'customer', b.customer.id); assert.equal(unknown.phase, 'unknown')
  await xeroSync(h, 'customer', b.customer.id, { error: 'XERO_UNCERTAIN' })
  h.xero.uncertain = false
  const before = h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length
  await xeroSync(h, 'customer', b.customer.id, { payload: { remoteId: 'synthetic-glove-missing' }, error: 'XERO_RECONCILE' }, 'xero.reconcile')
  const recovered = await xeroSync(h, 'customer', b.customer.id, { payload: { remoteId: 'synthetic-glove-contact-1' } }, 'xero.reconcile')
  assert.equal(recovered.phase, 'complete'); assert.equal(h.xero.calls.filter(r => r.body).length, before)
  await h.command('xero.map', { kind: 'customer', id: b.customer.id, version: (await current(h, 'customers', b.customer.id)).version, remoteId: 'synthetic-glove-contact-1' }, { error: 'XERO_LOCKED' })
  const trail = await assertTrail(h, ['xero.reserved', 'xero.complete', 'xero.rejected', 'xero.unknown', 'xero.reconciled', 'xero.replayed'])
  assert.ok(trail.activity.some(e => e.kind === 'xero.complete' && e.summary.includes(posted.remoteId)))
  assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(trail), /synthetic-glove-51|Bearer|00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/)
  const c = await current(h, 'customers', b.customer.id), preview = await h.command('privacy.preview', { customerId: c.id, version: c.version })
  await h.command('privacy.erase', { customerId: c.id, version: c.version, fingerprint: preview.fingerprint, confirm: 'ERASE' })
  assert.equal(await h.db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM glove_xero_operations WHERE record_id IN (?,?)').bind(c.id, invoice.id).first('n'), 0)
  await xeroSync(h, 'invoice', invoice.id, { error: 'ERASED' })
  const beforeReplay = h.xero.calls.length
  await h.command('xero.sync', customerPayload, { commandId: customerCommandId, error: 'ERASED' })
  assert.equal(h.xero.calls.length, beforeReplay)
  const saved = await h.db.prepare('SELECT result FROM glove_commands WHERE id=?').bind(customerCommandId).first('result')
  assert.doesNotMatch(saved, /synthetic-glove-contact-1|operationId|connectionId/)
}

body:
{
  const h = await installation(); t.after(() => h.close())
  const b = await fixture(h, '2025-01-01T16:00:00Z')
  let perVisit = await b.job('Per-visit PM'), fixed = await b.job('Quarterly PM billed monthly')
  perVisit = await b.repeat(perVisit, { mode: 'per-visit' })
  fixed = await b.repeat(fixed, { mode: 'fixed-monthly', lines: [line('240.00')] }, { date: '2025-01-15', rule: { unit: 'month', interval: 3 }, start: '13:00', end: '14:00' })
  await b.dispatcher.run('series.billing', { jobId: perVisit.id, version: perVisit.version, from: '2025-01-01', billing: { mode: 'per-visit' }, reason: 'Price authority refused' }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  const visits = []
  visits.push(await b.complete(perVisit, '2025-01-01', '1'))
  await clock(h, '2025-02-01T05:59:00Z')
  await h.scheduled('2025-02-01T05:59:00Z')
  await clock(h, '2025-02-05T16:00:00Z'); visits.push(await b.complete(perVisit, '2025-02-05', '2'))
  await clock(h, '2025-02-12T16:00:00Z'); visits.push(await b.complete(perVisit, '2025-02-12', '3'))
  const skipped = (await h.state()).visits.find(v => v.jobId === perVisit.id && v.local.date === '2025-02-19')
  await b.dispatcher.run('visit.cancel', { visitId: skipped.id, version: skipped.version, reason: 'Customer away' })
  await clock(h, '2025-03-01T05:59:00Z'); await b.office.run('series.billingRun', {})
  await clock(h, '2025-04-01T04:59:00Z')
  await Promise.all([h.scheduled('2025-04-01T04:59:00Z'), h.scheduled('2025-04-01T04:59:00Z')])
  const commandId = randomUUID(), first = await b.office.run('series.billingRun', {}, { commandId })
  assert.deepEqual(await b.office.run('series.billingRun', {}, { commandId }), first)
  const s = await h.state(), each = s.invoices.filter(i => i.jobId === perVisit.id), monthly = s.invoices.filter(i => i.jobId === fixed.id)
  assert.equal(each.length, 3); assert.equal(monthly.length, 3)
  assert.deepEqual(visits.map(v => each.find(i => i.recurring.visitId === v.id).revisions[0].totals.total), ['57.00', '64.00', '71.00'])
  assert.ok(!each.some(i => i.recurring.visitId === skipped.id))
  assert.deepEqual(monthly.map(i => [i.recurring.proposedIssuedOn, i.revisions[0].totals.total]), [['2025-01-31', '240.00'], ['2025-02-28', '240.00'], ['2025-03-31', '240.00']])
  assert.equal(new Set(s.invoices.map(i => i.recurring.key)).size, 6)
  assert.ok(s.invoices.every(i => i.status === 'draft' && !i.revisions[0].approval && !i.dates))
  assert.equal((await h.request('/api/glove/reports/revenue.json?from=2025-01-01&to=2025-03-31').then(r => r.json())).total.revenue, '0.00')
  assert.deepEqual((await h.request('/api/glove/reports/receivables.json?asOf=2025-03-31').then(r => r.json())).totals, [])
  await h.command('invoice.export', {}, { error: 'NOTHING_TO_EXPORT' })
  await h.command('invoice.prepare', { jobId: perVisit.id }, { error: 'RECURRING_BILLING' })
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 0)
  assert.ok(!(await b.techPerson.state()).jobs.find(j => j.id === perVisit.id).series.billing)
  assert.equal((await h.request('/api/glove/recurring-billing', { as: b.techPerson.cookie })).status, 403)
  await assertTrail(h, ['series.billingChanged', 'invoice.prepared', 'series.billingRun'])
  const branch = await h.command('branch.save', { name: 'North branch', prefix: 'NTH', timezone: 'America/Chicago', zips: [] })
  await h.command('branch.limit', { operatorId: b.office.id, branchId: branch.id })
  await b.office.run('invoice.approve', { invoiceId: monthly[0].id, version: monthly[0].version, revision: 1 }, { error: 'NOT_FOUND' })
  assert.deepEqual((await h.request('/api/glove/recurring-billing', { as: b.office.cookie }).then(r => r.json())).missed, [])
}

  await h.command('business.save', { ...businessRow, legalName: 'Synthetic Glove LLC', dba: 'Synthetic Trade', abn: '12-3456789', address: '125 Test Street, Austin TX 78701', phone: '(512) 555-0125', licenses: [{ trade: 'Plumbing', state: 'TX', number: 'synthetic-glove-9' }, { trade: 'HVAC', state: 'TX', number: 'synthetic-glove-10' }], insurance: { carrier: 'Synthetic Insurer', policy: 'synthetic-glove-11', expires: '2028-12-31' }, logo: { mediaType: 'image/png', base64: documentLogo } })
  businessRow = (await h.state()).business[0]
  await b.office.run('document.template', { kind: 'quote', version: businessRow.version, heading: 'Proposal', terms: 'No changes' }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  await h.command('document.template', { kind: 'quote', version: businessRow.version, heading: 'Your service proposal', terms: 'Payment due in 14 days.', footer: 'Thank you for choosing us.' })
  const service = await h.command('service.save', { code: 'DOC-1', name: 'Customer service line', description: 'A complete customer-facing service description.', unitPrice: '1850.00', unitCost: '1091.50', image: photo })
  let quote = await b.dispatcher.run('quote.draft', { customerId: b.customer.id, siteId: b.site.id, title: 'Customer-ready work', lines: [{ serviceId: service.id, description: service.name, quantity: '1', unitPrice: service.unitPrice }] })
  quote = await b.dispatcher.run('quote.approve', { quoteId: quote.id, version: quote.version, revision: 1 })
  await b.dispatcher.run('document.photo', { kind: 'quote', id: quote.id, version: quote.version, photo }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  quote = await h.command('document.photo', { kind: 'quote', id: quote.id, version: quote.version, photo, caption: 'Customer-facing site photo' })
  const link = await h.command('quote.link', { quoteId: quote.id, version: quote.version })
  const read = path => h.request('/api/glove/public/quote' + path, { as: '', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${link.token}` } })
  const opened = await read(''), d = (await opened.json()).document
  assert.equal(d.business.legalName, 'Synthetic Glove LLC')
  assert.equal(d.business.ein, '12-3456789')
  assert.deepEqual(d.business.licenses.map(l => l.number), ['synthetic-glove-9','synthetic-glove-10'])
  assert.equal(d.template.terms, 'Payment due in 14 days.')
  assert.equal(d.options[0].lines[0].customerDescription, service.description)
  assert.equal(d.options[0].lines[0].images[0].fileId, service.images[0].fileId)
  assert.equal(d.photos[0].caption, 'Customer-facing site photo')
  assert.equal(d.files.length, 3)
  for (const fileId of d.files) { const response = await read(`/files/${fileId}`); assert.equal(response.status, 200); assert.equal(Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()).toString('base64'), fileId === d.business.logo.fileId ? documentLogo : png) }
  const unrelated = await h.command('service.save', { code: 'DOC-2', name: 'Unrelated image', unitPrice: '1.00', image: photo })
  assert.equal((await read(`/files/${unrelated.images[0].fileId}`)).status, 404)
  assert.equal((await h.request(`/api/glove/public/quote/files/${d.files[0]}`, { as: '' })).status, 404)
  assert.equal((await h.request(`/api/glove/public/quote/files/${d.files[0]}?token=${link.token}`, { as: '' })).status, 404)
  businessRow = (await h.state()).business[0]
  await h.command('document.template', { kind: 'quote', version: businessRow.version, heading: 'Later heading', terms: 'Later terms', footer: '' })
  assert.deepEqual((await (await read('')).json()).document, d, 'issued customer document never changes with a template edit')
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(d).includes('1091.50'))
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(d).includes(b.customer.email))
  await assertTrail(h, ['document.template','document.photo','quote.linkIssued'])
  const customer = (await h.state()).customers.find(c => c.id === b.customer.id)
  await h.command('privacy.erase', { customerId: customer.id, version: customer.version, confirm: 'ERASE', fingerprint: (await h.command('privacy.preview', { customerId: customer.id, version: customer.version })).fingerprint })
  assert.equal((await read('')).status, 404)
  assert.equal((await read(`/files/${quote.documentPhotos[0].file.fileId}`)).status, 404)
  assert.equal((await h.request(`/api/glove/files/${quote.documentPhotos[0].file.fileId}`)).status, 404)
}

body:
{
  for (const provider of ['sendgrid', 'postmark', 'ses']) {
  const h = await installation(); t.after(() => h.close())
  const { b, signer } = await setup(h, provider)
  await clock(h, at(0))
  await b.office.run('reminder.configure', { enabled: false }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  await h.command('reminder.configure', { version: (await h.state()).business[0].version, enabled: true, approved: false }, { error: 'CONSENT' })
  const preview = await h.command('reminder.preview', { templates })
  assert.match(preview.visitReminder, /stop automatic emails/)
  assert.equal((await h.state()).business[0].messageAutomation, undefined)
  const policy = await configure(h)
  assert.equal(policy.preview.visitReminder, `Bring access instructions for 2026-11-01 at 10:00.\n\nHarbour Air & Electrical\n1400 Synthetic Street, Austin TX 78701\nContact the office to confirm, reschedule, or stop automatic emails. Replies are handled by the office.`)
  await h.command('reminder.configure', { version: policy.version, enabled: true, approved: true, templates: { ...templates, visitReminder: '{{secret}}' }, visitHours: [24], paymentDays: [], quoteDays: [] }, { error: 'INPUT' })
  const job = await h.command('job.create', { customerId: b.customer.id, siteId: b.site.id, title: 'Service visit' })
  let visit = await h.command('visit.book', { jobId: job.id, technicianId: b.priya.id, date: day(2), start: '10:00', end: '11:00' })
  await tick(h, at(0))
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 0, 'a recorded address alone never consents')
  await consent(h, b.customer.id, 'visits')
  await tick(h, at(0, '19:00'))
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 0, 'quiet hours hold confirmations')
  await tick(h, at(1, '08:00'))
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 1)
  assert.equal(body(h.email.sent[0]), `Booked Harbourview Dental on ${day(2)} at 10:00 (UTC).\n\nHarbour Air & Electrical\n1400 Synthetic Street, Austin TX 78701\nContact the office to confirm, reschedule, or stop automatic emails. Replies are handled by the office.`)
  await Promise.all([h.scheduled(at(1, '10:00')), h.scheduled(at(1, '10:00'))])
  assert.equal((await messages(h, 'visitReminder')).length, 1)
  assert.match(body(h.email.sent.at(-1)), /Bring access instructions/)
  await tick(h, at(2, '08:00'))
  assert.equal((await messages(h, 'visitReminder')).length, 2)
  await tick(h, at(2, '08:00'))
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 3, 'replaying cron does not resend')
  visit = (await h.state()).visits.find(v => v.id === visit.id)
  await b.office.run('visit.replyLink', { visitId: visit.id, version: visit.version }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  const replyId = 'synthetic-glove-visit-reply-1'
  const issued = await h.command('visit.replyLink', { visitId: visit.id, version: visit.version }, { commandId: replyId })
  const replyToken = /#token=(glv_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})/.exec(body(h.email.sent.at(-1)))[1]
  const publicReply = (method = 'GET', value, token = replyToken) => h.request('/api/glove/public/visit-response', { as: '', method, headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, ...(value ? { body: value } : {}) })
  const visibleVisit = await (await publicReply()).json()
  assert.deepEqual([visibleVisit.visit.date, visibleVisit.visit.start], [visit.local.date, visit.local.start])
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(visibleVisit).includes(b.customer.email))
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(visibleVisit).includes(b.site.address))
  const requestReply = await publicReply('POST', { action: 'reschedule' })
  assert.equal(requestReply.status, 200, await requestReply.clone().text())
  assert.equal((await publicReply('POST', { action: 'reschedule' })).status, 200)
  assert.equal((await publicReply('POST', { action: 'confirm' })).status, 409)
  const responded = await h.state(), requested = responded.enquiries.filter(e => e.visitId === visit.id && e.jobId === job.id)
  assert.equal(requested.length, 1, 'a replay opens no duplicate reschedule request')
  assert.equal(requested[0].status, 'new')
  assert.equal(responded.visits.find(v => v.id === visit.id).startAt, visit.startAt, 'a request never changes the booking')
  assert.ok(responded.events.some(e => e.kind === 'visit.customer.reschedule' && e.jobId === job.id))
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(await (await h.request('/api/glove/export')).json()).includes(replyToken))
  assert.deepEqual(await h.command('visit.replyLink', { visitId: visit.id, version: visit.version }, { commandId: replyId }), issued, 'recovery never sends another link')
  visit = (await h.state()).visits.find(v => v.id === visit.id)
  visit = await h.command('visit.change', { visitId: visit.id, version: visit.version, date: day(3), start: '12:00', end: '13:00', reason: 'Customer requested tomorrow' })
  await tick(h, at(2, '08:30'))
  assert.equal((await messages(h, 'moved')).length, 1)
  assert.equal((await publicReply()).status, 404, 'a changed schedule invalidates the old response credential')
  await h.command('visit.cancel', { visitId: visit.id, version: visit.version, reason: 'Customer cancelled' })
  await tick(h, at(2, '09:00'))
  assert.equal((await messages(h, 'cancelled')).length, 1)
  const count = h.email.sent.length
  await tick(h, at(3, '10:00'))
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, count, 'cancelled visit has no later reminders')
  const enquiry = await h.command('enquiry.create', { customerId: b.customer.id, siteId: b.site.id, description: 'Assess heater' })
  const assessment = await h.command('assessment.book', { enquiryId: enquiry.id, technicianId: b.priya.id, date: day(4), start: '11:00', end: '12:00' })
  await tick(h, at(3, '10:00'))
  assert.equal((await messages(h, 'confirmation')).length, 2)
  const first = (await messages(h, 'confirmation'))[0]
  const timestamp = Math.floor(new Date(at(3, '10:00')).getTime() / 1000)
  const delivery = [{ email: first.to, timestamp, event: 'delivered', sg_event_id: 'synthetic-glove-event', sg_message_id: 'sg-receipt-1.filter', rer_delivery_id: first.id }]
  assert.equal((await postEvents(h, { raw: JSON.stringify(delivery), headers: {} })).status, 401)
  assert.equal((await postEvents(h, signer.signed(delivery, { at: timestamp }))).status, 200)
  assert.equal((await h.state()).messageStates[first.id].status, 'delivered')
  let assessmentVisit = (await h.state()).visits.find(v => v.id === assessment.visit.id)
  await h.command('visit.replyLink', { visitId: assessmentVisit.id, version: assessmentVisit.version })
  const confirmToken = /#token=(glv_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})/.exec(body(h.email.sent.at(-1)))[1]
  assert.equal((await publicReply('POST', { action: 'confirm' }, confirmToken)).status, 200)
  assessmentVisit = (await h.state()).visits.find(v => v.id === assessmentVisit.id)
  assert.equal(assessmentVisit.customerResponses[0].action, 'confirm')
  await consent(h, b.customer.id, 'visits', false)
  assert.equal((await publicReply('GET', undefined, confirmToken)).status, 404, 'withdrawal closes the reply door immediately')
  await tick(h, at(4, '09:00'))
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, count + 2, 'withdrawal suppresses assessment reminder')
  await consent(h, b.customer.id, 'visits')
  await configure(h, { templates: { ...templates, reportReady: 'Completed {{title}} on {{date}}: your report is ready.' } })
  const reportVisit = await h.command('visit.book', { jobId: job.id, technicianId: b.tom.id, date: day(5), start: '12:00', end: '13:00' })
  await b.tomPerson.run('visit.arrive', { visitId: reportVisit.id, deviceTime: at(5, '12:00') })
  await b.tomPerson.run('visit.complete', { visitId: reportVisit.id, deviceTime: at(5, '13:00'), summary: 'synthetic-glove-2 completed work', signoff: { absentReason: 'Customer away' } })
  const report = (await h.state()).serviceReports.find(r => r.visitId === reportVisit.id)
  await b.office.run('report.link', { reportId: report.id, email: true }, { error: 'FORBIDDEN' })
  const reportPayload = { reportId: report.id, email: true }, reportCommand = 'synthetic-glove-report-email-1'
  const reportLink = await h.command('report.link', reportPayload, { commandId: reportCommand })
  assert.equal(reportLink.token, undefined, 'an emailed report credential is not exposed in the command response')
  const reportMail = h.email.sent.at(-1), reportToken = /#token=(glr_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})/.exec(body(reportMail))[1]
  assert.ok(body(reportMail).startsWith(`Completed Service visit on ${day(5)}: your report is ready.`))
  assert.match(body(reportMail), /stop automatic emails/)
  const receivedReport = await h.request('/api/glove/public/reports', { as: '', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${reportToken}` } })
  assert.equal(receivedReport.status, 200)
  assert.equal((await receivedReport.json()).report.summary, 'synthetic-glove-2 completed work')
  const sentCount = h.email.sent.length
  assert.deepEqual(await h.command('report.link', reportPayload, { commandId: reportCommand }), reportLink)
  assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, sentCount)
  const reportMessage = (await messages(h, 'reportReady'))[0]
  assert.equal((await h.state()).messageStates[reportMessage.id].status, 'accepted')
  const reportEvent = [{ email: reportMessage.to, timestamp: Math.floor(new Date(at(4, '09:00')).getTime() / 1000), event: 'delivered', sg_event_id: 'synthetic-glove-report-event', sg_message_id: (await h.state()).messageStates[reportMessage.id].providerMessageId, rer_delivery_id: reportMessage.id }]
  assert.equal((await postEvents(h, signer.signed(reportEvent, { at: reportEvent[0].timestamp }))).status, 200)
  const reportTimeline = (await (await h.request(`/api/glove/jobs/${job.id}/timeline`)).json()).events
  assert.ok(reportTimeline.some(e => e.kind === 'email.delivered' && e.subjectId === reportMessage.id))
  const reportStream = (await (await h.request(`/api/glove/conversation?jobId=${job.id}`)).json()).entries
  assert.ok(reportStream.some(e => e.id === `email:${reportMessage.id}` && /delivered/i.test(e.delivery)))

{
  const h = await installation(); t.after(() => h.close())
  const { b } = await setup(h)
  await clock(h, at(0))
  await configure(h, { visitHours: [], paymentDays: [], quoteCallDays: [2, 5, 10], quoteTextDays: [2, 5, 10] })
  await connectSms(h, b.customer.id, 'quotes')
  await consent(h, b.customer.id, 'quotes')
  const quotes = []
  for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) {
    let q = await h.command('quote.draft', { customerId: b.customer.id, siteId: b.site.id, title: `Service ${n}`, lines: [{ description: 'Repair', quantity: '1', unitPrice: '100.00' }], validUntil: day(n === 2 ? 7 : 30) })
    q = await h.command('quote.approve', { quoteId: q.id, version: q.version, revision: 1 })
    q = await h.command('quote.markSent', { quoteId: q.id, version: q.version, revision: 1, channel: 'email' })
    quotes.push(q)
  }
  await tick(h, at(1)); assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 0)
  await tick(h, at(2)); assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 3)
  await clock(h, at(3))
  const answering = (await h.state()).quotes.find(q => q.id === quotes[1].id)
  await h.command('quote.decline', { quoteId: answering.id, version: answering.version, revision: 1, method: 'phone', customerName: 'Customer', reason: 'No longer needed' })
  await tick(h, at(5)); assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 5)
  await tick(h, at(10)); assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 6)
  await tick(h, at(10)); assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 6)
  await clock(h, at(5)) // Return to the live session after the day-ten scheduler observation.
  const sent = await messages(h, 'quoteFollowup')
  assert.deepEqual(quotes.map(q => sent.filter(m => m.subjectId === q.id).length), [3, 1, 2])
  const textSteps = await textMessages(h, 'quoteFollowup')
  assert.deepEqual(quotes.map(q => textSteps.filter(m => m.subjectId === q.id).length), [3, 1, 2])
  assert.ok(h.twilio.calls.every(c => !c.body || c.body.Body.endsWith('Reply STOP to stop texts, HELP for help, START to request texts again.')))
  const taskQuotes = (await h.state()).quotes
  assert.deepEqual(quotes.map(q => taskQuotes.find(r => r.id === q.id).followupTasks.length), [3, 1, 2])
  assert.ok(taskQuotes.find(q => q.id === quotes[1].id).followupTasks.every(t => t.status === 'stopped'))
  assert.ok(taskQuotes.find(q => q.id === quotes[2].id).followupTasks.every(t => t.status === 'stopped'))
  assert.ok((await h.state()).events.some(e => e.kind === 'quote.followupTask'))
  assert.ok(h.email.sent.every(m => /\/email-preferences#token=gle_/.test(body(m)) && body(m).includes('1400 Synthetic Street, Austin TX 78701') && !body(m).includes('/quote#token=')), 'each quote follow-up has the mandatory unsubscribe link and postal address, never a quote bearer')
  const stopToken = /#token=(gle_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})/.exec(body(h.email.sent[0]))[1]
  const preference = (method = 'GET', value) => h.request('/api/glove/public/email-preferences', { as: '', method, headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${stopToken}` }, ...(value ? { body: value } : {}) })
  const beforeRead = (await h.state()).events.length
  assert.equal((await preference()).status, 200)
  assert.equal((await h.state()).events.length, beforeRead, 'opening an unsubscribe link never changes consent')
  const withdrawal = await preference('POST', { stop: true })
  assert.equal(withdrawal.status, 200, await withdrawal.clone().text())
  assert.equal((await preference('POST', { stop: true })).status, 200)
  assert.equal((await h.state()).customers.find(c => c.id === b.customer.id).automaticEmail.quotes.enabled, false)
  await configure(h, { visitHours: [], paymentDays: [], quoteDays: [20], quoteCallDays: [], quoteTextDays: [] })
  await tick(h, at(20)); assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 6, 'withdrawal stops a later still-valid unanswered quote step')
  await tick(h, at(31))
  await clock(h, at(5))
  assert.ok((await h.state()).quotes.find(q => q.id === quotes[0].id).followupTasks.every(t => t.status === 'stopped'), 'expiry retires pending call tasks even when no new message is due')
  // Erasure retires both queued intents and receipts through the existing customer door.
  const customer = (await h.state()).customers.find(c => c.id === b.customer.id)
  const preview = await h.command('privacy.preview', { customerId: customer.id, version: customer.version })
  await h.command('privacy.erase', { customerId: customer.id, version: customer.version, confirm: 'ERASE', fingerprint: preview.fingerprint })
  const exported = await h.request('/api/glove/export').then(r => r.json())
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(exported).includes(customer.email))
  await tick(h, at(11)); assert.equal(h.email.sent.length, 6)
}
